findings.value: An independent free house on Cambridge Heath Road, a former Truman pub, with real ales, a small heated courtyard, and pool and darts, according to its CAMRA WhatPub entry.

evidence.quote: Independent ex-Truman free house in Bethnal Green serving two regular ales

findings.value: CAMRA's WhatPub entry lists live music among the pub's facilities; the kind of nights is not stated.

notes: Only CAMRA WhatPub was read; one WebSearch found no press review. The page shows 'Last surveyed 11/01/2026'. No live-music listing was read, so it is not confirmed as current.
